summary: Client only. An NPC body shown only on this machine, for things a resource puts in front of its own player, such as a figure in a character creator, a guide or a preview. The server does not know about it, and no other player sees it. Without AI it stays where you put it. `ai: true` gives it the soul's brain, which a female NPC always has. A machine can have up to 64, and they end when their resource stops.

appearance.summary: Its character parts: { body, head, hair, beard }.

setPosition.summary: Moves the body, and turns it if a rotation is given.

setAppearance.summary: Changes character parts of its gender, as for Npc.setAppearance.

playAnimation.summary: Plays one of the game's animations, as for Npc.playAnimation.

say.summary: Shows the game's speech bubble over its head. '' removes it.

remove.summary: Removes the body from this machine's world.

create.summary: Creates a body shown only on this machine.

params.options: `position`, required; `soul`, the game soul's GUID, or `class`, 'NPC' or 'NPC_Female'; `name`; `rotation`; `appearance`; `ai`.

create.exampleLua:
-- client
local guide = kcds.characters.LocalNpc.create({ soul = "210170d8-afb2-4cbd-9df5-da2a8e722af4", name = "Guide", position = kcds.math.Vector3.new(100, 200, 10) })
guide:say("Follow the road to the mill.")

all.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, figure in ipairs(kcds.characters.LocalNpc.all()) do
  figure:remove()
end

exists.exampleLua:
-- client
if guide.exists then
  guide:remove()
end

setPosition.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local beside = kcds.players.LocalPlayer.position:clone():add(Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
guide:setPosition(beside, { z = 180 })

setAppearance.example:
// client: back to the soul's own hair
guide.setAppearance({ hair: '' });
setAppearance.exampleLua:
-- client: back to the soul's own hair
guide:setAppearance({ hair = "" })
setAppearance.exampleCs:
// client: back to the soul's own hair
guide.SetAppearance(new { hair = "" });

say.example:
// client
guide.say('Follow the road to the mill.', { duration: 5000 });
say.exampleLua:
-- client
guide:say("Follow the road to the mill.", { duration = 5000 })
say.exampleCs:
// client
guide.Say("Follow the road to the mill.", new { duration = 5000 });
